classification.difficultyReason: Find a calculator related angle and use the appropriate quadrants to obtain both solutions to the nearest degree.

content.prompt: Find, correct to the nearest degree, all values of $\theta$ between $0^\circ$ and $360^\circ$ such that:

answer.worked:
In degree mode, the related angle is $\alpha=\sin^{-1}(0.5735)$. Sine is positive in the first and second quadrants.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha\approx35^\circ\\\theta&=180^\circ-\alpha\approx145^\circ\end{align*}$$

Both values are rounded to the nearest degree.

In degree mode, the related angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}(0.58778)$. Cosine is negative in the second and third quadrants.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-\alpha\approx126^\circ\\\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\approx234^\circ\end{align*}$$

Both values are rounded to the nearest degree.

In degree mode, the related angle is $\alpha=\tan^{-1}(2.1445)$. Tangent is positive in the first and third quadrants.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha\approx65^\circ\\\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\approx245^\circ\end{align*}$$

Both values are rounded to the nearest degree.

In degree mode, the related angle is $\alpha=\sin^{-1}(0.8191)$. Sine is negative in the third and fourth quadrants.

$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\approx235^\circ\\\theta&=360^\circ-\alpha\approx305^\circ\end{align*}$$

Both values are rounded to the nearest degree.
